cause: First video of each shard (a trailer) has no stored frame count or duration in its stream header; the runner asserted both were present. No responses were written.
fix: Read fps, duration and frame count with the same fallbacks as the original HERBench probe_video (fps 24, duration end+1, frame count round(duration*fps)). If an estimated frame count exceeds the decodable frames, the missing indices take the last decoded frame; decode.jsonl records stored_frame_count and clamped_indices. Videos with a stored frame count are unaffected.
